scope.objective: Capture a bounded natural-play timing, input, simulation, audio, and actual-FRONT ledger for the frozen current artifact; do not optimize.
scope.only_natural_state_change: XRoar monitor inject_key press/release, at the exact source-qualified keyboard-service breakpoint

includes: IRQ execution occurring inside the interval
baseline.miss_rule: Each individual sample above 27000 is a miss; do not average it away.

historical_context_only.use: not a current baseline and does not establish natural three-enemy recurrence

baseline.receipt_revision_field: metadata only; do not use it alone to accept or reject the pinned source revision

excluded_inputs: current FEAT-010 authored attract/high-score TMX changes are excluded; they are not integrated in this frozen baseline
BUG-117 observer implementation files are not imported or depended upon
pins.preflight: Every listed path must exist and match its SHA256 before and after natural capture; any missing or changed artifact is a hard failure. Never rebuild or substitute a component ROM for the delivered ROM.

enemy_state.tag_rule: occupied tag low nibble is 1; high nibble is source kind

audio_state.cue6_terminal_rule: slot0 id 6, cursor equals the authored cue-6 terminal-zero address, then a naturally observed 6-to-255 slot transition; later output action 2 must publish mute values and busy 0

audio_binding.entry_private_stack_use: PSHS A before changing PAR5, PULS A before JSR $B638; the private byte is not present on the API-entry stack
audio_binding.return_private_stack_use: $0488 stops before PSHS A restores PAR5; S must exactly equal the $047C entry S and the top return PC must be unchanged

direct_caller_stack_rules.adaptive_work: S at $047C equals outer AD_WORK_EXEC entry S-2: exactly the direct JSR return word, with no caller-private push live at these five source callsites
direct_caller_stack_rules.adaptive_tick_binding: S top word is the exact $0518 JSR return; source PSHS A at $0511 remains at S+2 and is read-only checked as its source-derived 0/1 barrier result
direct_caller_stack_rules.binding_private_pushes: The binding's own push-A at $047C is popped before the banked JSR; the return push-A begins after the $0488 stop

tail_call.stack_relation: S at $047C equals S at $038F because aw_output JMP adds no return word

dispatch_stub.use: vector used by adaptive_install_active outside the measured worklist; never register it as an audio-entry breakpoint

api_code.qualification: page-$3D physical bytes at entry; at $0488 require PAR5=$3D and compare source-pinned artifact, page-$3D physical, and live CPU bytes

psg_write.required_cpu_physical_audio_bytes: STA $FF51 at $A499-$A49B, stop after store at $A49C
psg_write.required_callsite_check: return-2 contains the exact relative BSR whose signed target is $A499
psg_write.wrong_owner_or_alias: invalidate detailed audio-write attribution; never waive or count it as audio

presentation_flow_tick.source: src/presentation_runtime.s; org $1900 immediately precedes the symbol
presentation_flow_tick.physical_mapping: PAR0 masked to six bits must equal page $38; read the page-$38 physical span at offset $1900
required_equalities: pinned authored source and source receipt input
pinned presentation module and map symbol/range
presentation_flow_tick.startup_wrapper: presentation_key_service $DF24 calls key_service with B=3 during startup defaults initialization; it is not a recurring input boundary

audio_module.comparison: compare immutable bytes against the pinned audio module; skip only these historically qualified mutable ranges
audio_module.cpu_window_rule: read an Axxx CPU window only when PAR5 masked to six bits equals $3D; otherwise use the explicit page-$3D physical space

input.matrix_to_dscan: project_column=matrix//8; physical_row=matrix%8; row 0..5 maps to dscan_row=(physical_row+2)%6; row 6 maps to 6; row 7 is invalid; DSCAN=dscan_row*8+project_column
input_boundaries: presentation_flow_tick $1900; exact registered breakpoint id/PC plus source, staged, physical page-$38 and live CPU byte equality; PAR0=$38
natural_sequence: At the naturally displayed attract screen only, coin DSCAN 5 press then release on consecutive qualified input boundaries.

At the naturally displayed high-score/credit menu with credits present only, Enter DSCAN 48 press then release on consecutive qualified input boundaries. Record $A9 as observed event state; never inject it as a key.

After entry reaches mode 0, screen 2, context 1, entry 0, death 0, cue-6 completion/mute, busy 0 and an actual FRONT publication, press/release the live-source-derived Up binding at qualified input boundaries. Hold only until a natural input-state and movement response is observed, then release.
input.acceptance: Injection response is not acceptance. Require source-qualified state change plus PLAYER_DIR/PLAYER_WANT/JOY_DIR or cell/step response and an actual FRONT pixel witness. Any unrecognized live binding fails closed.

capture.timeout_meaning: Required phase marker absent at this observation boundary; not evidence that target code is slow.
capture.stop_rule: Stop and reassess after two rejected probes, two observation-tool timeouts, or one material scope/cause expansion.
worklist_fields: event_ticks at entry and return, divided by 8 only when wrap-safe delta is divisible by 8
enemy active byte plus all four source-tagged records, released count, death and entry flags
AD_SIM_TIME read only from physical page $3D
front owner, pending/commit/sim/missed sequence and VOFF1
audio queue, slot/voice, mix periods/attenuation/noise, shadows, busy, API action intervals and qualified PSG writes
monitor stop count and per-stop event_ticks before/after

pickup_classification.PICKUP_TIMER_nonzero: intentional collectible pause; preserve as a separate worklist class, do not describe ignored input or held movement as CPU lag
pickup_classification.FREEZE_TIMER_nonzero: record separately as enemy-freeze state; do not collapse into pickup classification
pickup_classification.DEATH_STATE_or_INITIAL_ENTRY_STATE_nonze: transition/entry work, separate from regular controllable gameplay
pickup_classification.regular_controllable: entry=0, death=0, pickup=0; report enemy-freeze flag alongside it

front_pixel_proof.actor_window: 8 bytes by 16 rows from the source-qualified PLAYER_FB and each active enemy record's stored framebuffer pointer; require at least one natural visible change tied to the input/animation sequence
front_pixel_proof.publication: commit sequence increments; pending retires; missed count unchanged; FRONT ID agrees with VOFF1; physical scanout is read-only

capture.event_edges: Recurrence is based on distinct AD_SIM_TIME changes and ENEMY_TIMER/ENEMY_ANIM state edges, never call count.

audio.existing_shadow_fact: Eleven shadows suppress unchanged continuation/attenuation/noise output; tone latches remain selected before possible data writes.
audio.bootstrap_alias: Install the PSG watchpoint only after the naturally displayed credit menu and current audio-module/runtime ownership have been byte-qualified; do not classify earlier bootstrap writes as gameplay audio.

accounting.outer: One inclusive $038F-to-$C116 total per worklist; includes IRQ and excludes preceding SYNC.
accounting.subspans: Only accept exact registered marker id/PC, live bytes, physical/source artifact bytes, mapped owner, and validated dynamic caller/return; otherwise retain cycles as residual. Adaptive audio is timed only from the real $047C binding through $0488; the $039B vector is not counted. Each span retains exact direct-call or aw_output tail-call ownership and reconciles once as a non-overlapping inclusive interval.
accounting.reconciliation: outer inclusive = qualified non-overlapping inclusive interval buckets + explicit residual; IRQ gets a separate bucket only if its exact span is independently source/byte/stack-qualified.
accounting.invalidity: Overlaps, unqualified alias/mapping, negative residual, non-divisible ticks, or missing endpoints invalidate component attribution while preserving the outer total.
accounting.observer_overhead: Record every stop's event_ticks before/after and total stops. State correction unavailable unless a naturally equivalent lower-stop comparison exists; never subtract an estimate or infer game cost from host wall time.
accounting.rank_gate: No candidate rank, causal claim, savings, or payoff ratio until current-artifact recurring impact is observed and component accounting reconciles. Audio remains a hypothesis.

runtime_protocol.deferred_import: Load those modules only inside --natural-gameplay after hash preflight. Never import BUG-117 observer modules or forced BUG-058 profilers.
exec_breakpoints: $1900 only for recurring source-qualified input boundaries
$038F/$C116 only after active-driver and resident-byte identity
$047C/$0488 only after active-driver, caller, stack, and PAR qualification
runtime_protocol.banked_audio_exec_breakpoints: none; $B638 code is qualified at the $047C/$0488 low-RAM binding bracket with PAR5=$3D only at return; classify detailed PSG write stops through the sole $FF51 watchpoint and mapped bytes
runtime_protocol.watchpoints: At most one: $FF51 length 1 kind w; list and prove exact identity before and after installing it.
runtime_protocol.stop_id: Execution stops require registered id and PC equality. Watchpoint stops have no id in current monitor implementation and are accepted only when the sole watchpoint exists and all $A49C/PAR5/callsite/byte guards pass.

input_state_machine.forced_release: Denied; monitor wrapper rejects release without an outstanding press
input_state_machine.startup_DF24: Never used as recurring input breakpoint

report_rules.coverage: Required three-enemy coverage absent means diagnosis incomplete. Optional four-enemy absence is recorded as absent, never pass.
report_rules.impact: Report misses by phase/worklist first; owner is secondary metadata. Do not compare unlike phases as owner A/B causes.
report_rules.release_priority: Pre-1.0 proposal only for evidenced recurring regular-play impact plus bounded high-yield remedy, or a confirmed audio sequencing/correctness fault. Other misses remain post-1.0 proposals after user review.
report_rules.no_claim_from_user_feel: User report that slowdown is usually imperceptible informs priority but is not an instrumented timing pass.

rejected_DF24_assumption.assumption: Treat presentation_key_service at $DF24 as the recurring input boundary
rejected_DF24_assumption.discriminator: src/main.s calls it once in startup with B=3 to initialize defaults; recurring mainloop calls presentation_flow_tick at $1900, whose source invokes scan_keys before dispatch
rejected_DF24_assumption.decision: Use $1900 with exact source/staged/physical/live and PAR0 qualification; never arm $DF24 for input

audio_api_stack_ownership.rejected_assumption: Expect S to advance by two bytes between the $039B dispatch vector and the $0488 post-call return
audio_api_stack_ownership.discriminator: The actual callable binding is $047C. Its private PSHS A/PULS A pair completes before JSR $B638; $0488 is after that call and before the wrapper's restore-PAR5 PSHS A. S therefore equals its value at $047C, and the stacked caller return word is unchanged.
audio_api_stack_ownership.decision: Require exact S and stacked return-PC equality across each source-qualified $047C-to-$0488 API interval

audio_binding_breakpoint.rejected_assumption: Use the $039B AD_AUDIO_EXEC vector stub as the sole runtime API-entry breakpoint
audio_binding_breakpoint.discriminator: The map/source place the actual binding at $047C. Six callsites JSR directly there, including five worklist callers and one adaptive_tick_binding caller; aw_output at $0424 loads action 2 then tail-JMPs from $0426, preserving the outer main-loop return PC $C152. The $039B JMP stub is used by adaptive_install_active outside the worklist and would miss direct calls or double-count routed calls.
audio_binding_breakpoint.decision: Register only $047C and pair it with $0488 while a worklist is open. Accept only the six exact source/map/live-qualified direct callsites or the $0426 tail path with S unchanged from $038F and stacked return PC $C152. Do not set a breakpoint at $039B.
